mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_transaction_outbox (order_id, payload, status, attempts, created_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{payload}, 'PENDING', 0, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, payload, status, attempts, last_error, created_at, sent_at FROM order_transaction_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
